Partner Programs Don't Fail.
Partner Tech Stacks Do.

 
Most organizations run partner programs on a fragmented partner technology stack. One system for PRM. Another for partner marketing. Separate tools for enablement, training, and reporting. As you expand to manage resellers, ISVs, influencers, and alliances in a modern ecosystem, this fragmentation is only accelerated. None of the tools talk to each other.

 

 
The result is predictable

 
Partners disengage

 
Partner managers chase updates

 
Partner marketing teams push content that never gets used

 

 

 

 
Mindmatrix replaces fragmented tools with a single

 
AI-Powered Partner Operating System

 
where AI, data, & execution are unified. One system that works for partners, partner account managers, partner marketing teams, & partner program & experience owners.

 

 

 


 

 

 

 

 

 
Partner Marketing 
 Automation (TCMA) 
 That Actually Gets Used


 

 
TO • THROUGH • WITH • FOR

 
Most partner marketing platforms distribute assets and hope partners execute. Mindmatrix closes the gap between hope, content, and action.

 

 

 
For Partner Marketing Managers:

 
AI turns a single corporate campaign into thousands of localized, co-branded partner campaigns that are ready to execute, in seconds.

 
For Partners:

 
Automated execution across email, social, video, and local campaigns without needing marketing expertise.

 
Concierge Execution:

 
When partners don't have the time, our human team and our AI, execute on their behalf. Partner participation is no longer optional or aspirational. It's easy.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
AI-Powered Partner 
 Relationship Management 
 (PRM)


 

 
Think • Build • Operate

 
Traditional PRM software acts as a system of record. Names, tiers, documents, and little action. Mindmatrix transforms PRM into an AI-driven system of execution and outcomes.

 

 

 
For Partner Account Managers:

 
Real-time pipeline visibility without manual reporting. Automated onboarding, deal registration, tiering, and multi-partner deal workflows driven by rules, automation, and AI signals.

 
For Partners:

 
An AI-guided, self-service experience that feels like a home base and operates in the way that partners like to work. Partners see what matters, complete what's required, and get back to selling faster.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
Channel Sales Enablement 
 Built Into the Platform


 

 
Enable • Guide • Close

 
Channel sales enablement shouldn't live in a separate LMS, sales platform, marketplace, locator, or content repository. 
 Mindmatrix embeds enablement and selling directly into the partner workflow, with AI-guided sequences and solution locators that help partners progress deals from first conversation to close.

 

 

 
For Partner Managers:

 
Ensure partners complete training, certifications, and sales readiness milestones, then guide them through structured sales sequences that move deals forward.

 
For Partners:

 
Contextual access to sales plays, sequences, solution locators, and deal guidance based on what they're selling and where they are in the deal cycle.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
Partner Ecosystem 
 Orchestration, Not Just 
 Channel Management


 

 
Discover • Connect • Win

 
Modern ecosystems include resellers, referral partners, alliances, ISVs, GSI's and influencers. Mindmatrix orchestrates all partner types in one system.

 

 

 
Marketplace & Discovery:

 
Partners can find, configure, and quote solutions alongside their own services. This includes intelligent 
Solution and Partner Locators
 to easily match customer needs with the right ecosystem partners and offerings.

 
Ecosystem intelligence:

 
AI identifies influence revenue, collaboration opportunities, and which partners should work together to win accounts. This intelligence enables seamless collaboration and joint selling across complex deals for maximum win-rates and increased partner-led revenue.

Software Alone Doesn't
Drive  Adoption. Execution Does.

 
Mindmatrix combines software with 
unlimited services and support
 to turn partner strategy into execution. Adoption, engagement, and results are engineered, not left to chance.

 

 
 

 

 
Unlimited Support

 
Configuration, optimization, partner assistance, and ongoing support are included. When partners struggle to execute, our team and AI step in to keep programs moving.

 

 

 

 
 

 

 
Built to Scale

 
From early-stage partner programs to global partner ecosystems, the platform and services evolve as your business grows, without forcing you to add tools or headcount.

AI is not a Feature.
It's the 
Foundation.

Partner Relationship Management (PRM)
,

Channel Sales Enablement,
 and 
Partner Ecosystem Orchestration
 in a single AI-powered partner operating system.

 

 

 

 
01

 
Predictive Insights

 
Identify which partners are ready to close, which are stalling, and where intervention is needed.

 

 

 
03

 
Conversational Guidance

 
A 24/7 AI assistant removes friction for partners and managers. No searching. No guessing.

 

 

 
02

 
Generative Content

 
Instantaneously create and localize co-branded marketing campaigns, sales plays, and training materials, eliminating content bottlenecks and driving speed-to-market.

 

 

 
04

 
Admin Automation

 
Intelligent AI agents automate time-consuming administrative tasks, including deal registration, data cleaning, tier management, and many other tasks that free up Partner Account Managers and partners to focus solely on selling.
